name: Rhode Island Youth Theatre – A Christmas Carol (Fall 2026 Production)
street_address: 1800 Post Road (Warwick Plaza, Set the Barre Dance Studio)
description_short: Nonprofit youth theatre company's fall production of the full musical A Christmas Carol for ages 7-18. Rehearsals run on weekends, Wednesdays and school holidays from October to December, ending with two shows on December 11-12 in Warwick.

warnings: This page describes a fall 2026 holiday theatre production (Oct 10 - Dec 12, 2026), not a summer camp. There are no 2027 summer camp details on the page.
The program has already started: casting was Oct 10, 2026 and today is Oct 13, 2026. Late registration may or may not be accepted.
Sibling discount: '$260 off when registering 2 siblings'. Payment plan: $285 now, then $200 by end of November.

The page uses two venues. Casting and rehearsals are at Set the Barre Dance Studio, 1800 Post Road, Warwick, RI 02886. Tech rehearsals and shows are at Warwick Veterans Middle School Auditorium, 2401 W Shore Road, Warwick, RI 02889.
Instagram posts on the page mention a past summer season in North Kingstown (Seussical Jr., Sound of Music Youth Edition) with no year or 2027 dates.
Attendance is required during tech week (Dec 8-12). Other conflicts are accommodated.
